headline: Nelco Q2 Net Profit Rises 7% YoY, Margins Expand
hook: Tata satcom firm reports modest quarterly growth
summary: Nelco reported a 7% year-on-year increase in net profit for the second quarter, alongside a 5.1% growth in revenue. However, profit contracted by 26% compared to the previous June quarter. The company also disclosed a $20 million investment in Lunar Holdco made in August. Indian retail investors tracking Tata Group equities can assess this as a steady but sequential profit contraction for the niche satellite communications provider.
whats_next: Next quarterly earnings release in January
why_it_matters: Sequential profit drop offsets steady year-on-year revenue gains.

headline: Nelco reports financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
summary: Nelco Limited has formally submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing provides the company's financial performance and operational updates for the second quarter of the fiscal year. Retail investors can review the earnings data on the exchange to assess the company's revenue and profit trends.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data updates your valuation thesis for Nelco.
